verdictWhy: I can't put this on the backup machine for Songbook. The click has nowhere to go but the same output as the tracks, and it came across from QLab silent, so the band would have no click at all. The track will vamp and leave the vamp on the bar, but the click doesn't go round with it and my Devamp cues do nothing, so the vamp is a mouse job with the band out of time. Load to Time, renumber and panic are as good as QLab; fix outputs and slices and I'd look again.

tasks.notes: Import from QLab opened all 18 cues with a plain list of what did not come across: slices kept as markers without counts, Devamp only for whole-file loops, MIDI/Mic/Timecode turned into Memos that do nothing. It said nothing about output routing or the click's level.

There is one output device for the whole app and buses are only faders; no cue or bus can be sent to outputs 3 and 4. The click cues came in at -inf dB, so the rule is kept only because the click is silent everywhere. Raise it and it goes to the house with the track.

Made a loop region 0:16-0:24 from the imported markers; it does not loop until you click its block in a strip that appears while the track plays. The track then went round three times and left cleanly at the end of the pass when I clicked the block again. But the click cue kept running straight on, and GO on the Devamp cue did nothing.
A loop region has no play count: it is hold until clicked. The import report said the counts were dropped, so I knew before a run.
Cmd+T, 25, Enter, Space: track and click both from 0:25, 'LOADED TO 0:25.0' beside GO. Repeating is Esc, select 20, Cmd+T, 25, Enter, Space; the time is not remembered.
Select 30 to 33, Cmd+R, Start at 300: 300-305 in one go, targets of the Devamp/Load/Fade followed.

Typed -9 in the Level field while it played; heard at -9 at once, '8 unsaved' chip appeared, and it was -9 after saving and playing again. Trouble: could not select the running row by clicking it where it normally is, and the first save into a folder stopped the track.
Esc fades over 2 s, Esc again is silence. Playhead is left on the next cue, so back to the top of the number is Up three times (through the group's children), then Space.

findings.title: No output routing: the click cannot be sent to outputs 3 and 4, away from the house
findings.expected: A device patch with outputs per cue, as QLab has: tracks on 1-2, click on 3-4 of the eight-output interface.
findings.happened: Settings > Audio has one 'Output device' ('Where the show's sound goes on this computer') and buses that are faders only ('Every Audio cue plays on a bus; each bus has a fader in the mixer'). The cue's Audio tab has Level and Bus, nothing about outputs. Nowhere does it say in words that routing is not there; I worked it out by not finding it. The manual says nothing either.
findings.steps: Import Songbook.qlab5, select 'Opening click', Audio tab; then the mixer's gear (Settings > Audio).
findings.suggestion: Until buses can be patched to device outputs, say so on the Audio settings page and in the import report.

findings.title: Holding a loop region loops the track but not the click in the same group, so they drift apart
findings.expected: Track and click in one group vamp together; in QLab both cues have the same slices and one Devamp releases both.
findings.happened: With 'Slice 2' held on Opening track, hear gave 'Opening track ... 0:17.3 of 0:48.0, held in a loop' and 'Opening click ... 0:41.3 of 0:48.0'. Same in the Finale: track 0:26.8 held, click 0:36.8. The click cue had no markers or region of its own and there is no way to hold two cues with one action. (The click was also silent, see the import finding, but its position is what matters.)
findings.steps: Import Songbook.qlab5. Opening track > Time & Loops > Make from markers. Select 10, Space. Click the running 'Opening track' row on its name, click the 'Slice 2' block in the strip, wait past 0:24, compare the two times in Active cues.

findings.title: An imported click cue arrives at -inf dB and the import report does not mention it
findings.expected: The click was at level on outputs 3-4 in QLab. Either it comes in audible, or the report tells me its routing was dropped and it is now silent.
findings.happened: All three click cues have Level '-inf'; Active cues shows '−∞' and hear shows '-60.0 dB'. The import report lists slices, Devamp, MIDI, Mic and Timecode but nothing about outputs or levels. A band would have started the Opening with no click. I cannot tell whether this is the importer reading the level of outputs 1-2 or something in my workspace.
findings.steps: Import Songbook.qlab5, OK, Space on cue 10, look at Active cues: 'Opening click' shows −∞.
findings.suggestion: Add a line to the import report for every cue whose output routing was dropped.

findings.title: A Devamp cue does nothing to a held loop region, and says nothing
findings.expected: GO on 'Out of the vamp' ends the vamp at the end of the pass. It is the cue the MD's whole Opening depends on.
findings.happened: With the track 'HOLDING', Space on 11 'Out of the vamp' moved the playhead to 12 and the track stayed 'held in a loop' and went round again. Same with 303 in the Finale. The import report did warn 'a Devamp here ends a whole-file loop after its pass; slices are not here yet', but at the moment of GO nothing on screen says the cue had no effect.
findings.steps: As the finding above, then press Space with 11 standing by while the region is held.
findings.suggestion: Let Devamp release a held region on its target.

findings.title: Leaving a vamp is a mouse click on a small block, not a GO
findings.expected: Vamp starts by itself when the track reaches it and I leave with the space bar, hands near the keyboard.
findings.happened: The region only loops if I click its block before the track gets there ('Click to hold the track in this section'), and I let go by clicking '⟳ Slice 2' again ('Holding here: click to let go'). The block only shows when that track is the one selected; when the selection moved to the click, the strip showed the click and the block was gone. Miss the click before bar 9 and the track plays straight through, which is what happened on my first pass.
findings.steps: Make a region, GO the group without clicking anything: the track plays through 0:24.

findings.title: No counted vamp: a loop region cannot play four times and go on
findings.expected: A play count per slice, as in QLab.
findings.happened: Time & Loops shows 'Slice 2 · 0:20.0 – 0:30.0' with only a × beside it. The import report said plainly 'had 3 slices: kept as markers, without their play counts'. There was also no marker at 0:38 for the end of the bows vamp.
findings.steps: Import, select Finale track, Time & Loops, Make from markers.

findings.title: Saving the show into a new folder stops everything that is playing
findings.expected: Saving never touches playback. I changed a level during the number and pressed Cmd+S.
findings.happened: First Cmd+S on the imported show (it asks for a folder): the Ballad was at 0:29, afterwards hear said 'Silence.', Active cues 'Nothing is running', playhead back on 10. Did it again with File > Save Show As… at 0:16: silence again. A plain Cmd+S on an already-saved show did not stop the sound.
findings.steps: Import Songbook.qlab5, select 20, Space, Cmd+S, give a folder. Or on a saved show: play, File > Save Show As…, give a new folder.

findings.title: Rows of running cues collapse in the list and cannot be clicked where they were
findings.expected: A running cue's row looks like the others with a countdown, and clicking it selects it.
findings.happened: While a group plays, its row and its children lose number, icon and time columns; only the name shows, pushed to the far left ('▾ Ballad', 'Ballad track', 'Ballad click'). Clicking the row in the middle selects nothing and the inspector says 'Select a cue to see its settings.' Clicking on the name at the left works. Seen on the Opening, the Ballad and the Finale. The list also scrolls when the group starts, so the row I aimed at had moved.
findings.steps: Import, select 20, Space, look at rows 20 and its children; click 'Ballad track' at the middle of the row.

findings.title: A loop region does not say that it will not loop until clicked during playback
findings.expected: Having made 'Loop regions: Slice 2 · 0:16.0 – 0:24.0', I expected GO to vamp there.
findings.happened: The track played through. The explanation ('the operator can hold the track there') is shown only while there are no regions, and does not say where. The hold strip appeared only after I happened to click a running row.
findings.steps: Opening track > Time & Loops > Make from markers; select 10, Space; wait to 0:30.

findings.title: Load to Time forgets the last time
findings.expected: Twenty times a rehearsal from 0:25: the box could offer the last time used for that cue.
findings.happened: Cmd+T opens with an empty box each time ('0:00' placeholder). It is the same count of presses as QLab, no worse.

findings.title: The import report is plain about what did not come across
findings.expected: A silent import and surprises in the run.
findings.happened: One box, five lines, cue numbers and names: 'kept as markers, without their play counts', 'slices are not here yet', 'was a MIDI cue: kept as a Memo that does nothing'. The standing-by line repeats it: '(QLab MIDI cue: not in Endless Cues yet. It does nothing here.)'.

findings.title: Load to Time works as in QLab, on a group, with the same key
findings.happened: Cmd+T, type 25, Enter: 'LOADED TO 0:25.0' beside GO, and Space started track and click together at 0:25. Typing works straight after Cmd+T.

findings.title: Renumber is one step and targets follow
findings.happened: Cmd+R, 'Renumber 6 cues', Start at 300, Step 1: 300 to 305, and the Devamp, Load and Fade then read '301 · Finale track'.

findings.title: Panic, live level and the unsaved chip behave as their labels say
findings.expected: Esc to stop; a level change that is heard at once and survives a save.
findings.happened: Esc: 'fading to -60 dB' over 2 s; Esc again: silence. Level typed as -9 was heard at -9 at once, a '↺ Put back to −6 dB' appeared beside it, the title bar showed 'N unsaved', and after Save it played at -9. The 'HOLDING — click the block to let go' badge and yellow block are easy to read.
findings.steps: Play any group, Esc, Esc. Play the Ballad, type -9 in Level, Enter, Cmd+S.

rig: After Space and Esc keys, the first Up arrow once seemed to do nothing; later Up presses worked. Probably keyboard focus in the rig, not reported.

Clicking a row by coordinates right after GO sometimes hit the neighbouring row because the list scrolls when a group starts; partly the rig's fixed coordinates, partly the app (noted in the running-rows finding).
